newsitem.title: USA: Dow pushes higher, NYSE sets curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow pushes higher, NYSE sets curbs.

text.p: U.S. blue chip stocks added to session gains on Thursday and Nasdaq powered higher as recently-downtrodden technology stocks rebounded.
The Dow Jones industrial average was trading up around 63 points at 7333, after a quick move higher late in the morning prompted the New York Stock Exchange to set curbs on trading.

The Nasdaq composite index was up 0.85 percent or around 12 points at 1391, boosted by strength in most technology stocks, including semiconductor and software stocks, as well as personal computer makers.
